nuggets.text: Goose Crowder got his nickname from his favorite movie character, Goose from Top Gun.
The Trojans sealed a 24-21 opening win over Sam Houston by recovering an onside kick with just over a minute left.
Troy fans yell Havoc in unison during the pregame show, cued by a passage from Shakespeare's Julius Caesar.
The Trojans stunned LSU 24-21 in 2017, snapping the Tigers' 46-game nonconference home winning streak.
In 2016 the Trojans became the first Sun Belt team ever ranked in the AP Top 25.
The Trojans own three national titles: the 1968 NAIA crown and Division II championships in 1984 and 1987.
Gerad Parker, a former Kentucky receiver, was Notre Dame's offensive coordinator before taking over at Troy.
Donnie Smith led the Sun Belt with 11 sacks last season and is the league's preseason Defensive Player of the Year.
Evan Crenshaw's 45.69-yard punting average last season was the second-best in Troy history.
The Trojans are 2-0 all-time against Alabama State, with wins in 2006 and 2017.
